title: 7AA.1 DIMASSOC DXF reference remapping
scope: Apply output identity remapping to the DIMASSOC object and owner handles
Resolve dimension and ordered osnap links through the configured resolver or source remap
Fail closed before publication when a nonzero required reference resolves to zero

implementation.summary: DIMASSOC now remaps its own nonzero handle and owner. Nonzero dimension and osnap references use the reference resolver when configured, whose result is treated as final, or source-handle remapping otherwise. The writer resolves these links before opening a record transaction and rejects a nonzero link that resolves to zero; the transaction also prevents partial-record publication on subsequent writer failures.
implementation.limitations: This does not expand the DIMASSOC model or implement live associative updates, omitted parameter/subentity/intersection/xref semantics, or DWG support. Existing guards for unrepresentable detail remain.

commands.result: passed; ASCII/Binary remap-only, resolver-precedence, ordered-reference, sentinel, and dimension/osnap zero-link no-publication cases included
